component.name: DuckyDeck Studio
component.summary: KDE Plasma 6 Configurator & AI Macro Architect for duckyPad Pro

description.p: DuckyDeck Studio is a modern Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami desktop application for programming the duckyPad Pro (2024+) and original duckyPad (2020) mechanical macropads on Linux.

ul.li: Interactive 4x5 RGB mechanical switch matrix, rotary encoders, and 32 expansion channels
Live USB HID communication for profile switching, per-key RGB, RTC sync, and PGV (_GV0.._GV31) editing
Native KDE Plasma 6 Wayland active-window auto-switcher via KWin D-Bus scripting
AI Profile Architect grounded in local ~/.config/kglobalshortcutsrc KDE keybindings

description.p: Simultaneous multi-device support for duckyPad Pro and duckyPad (2020) with isolated per-device profile caches, per-device Auto-Switcher rules, and per-device Desktop OLED Widgets; high-resolution mouse/Ploopy wheel smooth scrolling; and DuckyDeck Studio Custom Firmware v1.1.2 for both duckyPad Pro (DDS_FW_1.1.2_0f85dab1.bin with 4 customizable OLED layout styles and universal DPP_FW_ OTA staging) and duckyPad 2020 (DDS20_FW_1.1.2_3bd4beef.dfu with 204 monochrome icons, SWC_FADE_TO smooth RGB fade, dirty-page I2C OLED refresh, RTC backup register profile cache, and software Jump-to-DFU).

Full Windows 10/11 (x86_64) support with Inno Setup installer and portable ZIP, expanded 165-icon OLED icon library across 13 categories, New Profile Wizard with step-by-step setup, application window picker, automated rule creation, online keyboard shortcut discovery, and drag-and-drop hotkey assignment.
